replies.author: Joao_Victor
replies.body:
Your hacks were very obvious, all of our regular mods (Not Junior Mods, full ones) have been here for an average of 5+ months, everyone makes mistakes, but it was very obvious.

"I am also a Mod on a quite popular server why would I hack"
Just because you're a Mod there doesn't mean you don't hack here...

"and if you don't believe me well screen share with me through Skype"
You can easily just delete the hacked client and trash the recycling bin, not worth it.    

"I was in a call with two other staff members and one of them was kind enough to let me use their forum account because I couldn't get on the server to register on the forums(Very insufficient by the way)"

If you're going to write a ban appeal, at least tell the truth, none of our staff are stupid enough to do that, even with a friend.    

"oh and by the way this is XforceoffiveX"

So you get banned, then hop on an alt and make a report? You just earned yourself another ban.

You can e-mail support@avicus.net to appeal, our contact a director on Skype, but you probably won't since you ban evaded.
